---
shortcodes:
  - skillopt.lua
filters:
  - html-helper
  - pdf-helper
# 编号深度止于 subsubsection（#### → \paragraph 不编号，与原始论文一致；
# 原始论文 article 默认 secnumdepth 3，paragraph 标题无自动编号）
number-depth: 3
format:
  pdf:
    # 原版 arXiv 用 pdflatex；quarto 的 xelatex 模板会加载 unicode-math，
    # 实测其与 \textsubscript/\textbf 等字体切换冲突——切换后数学符号
    # （−/→/τ/∑ 等）全部丢失（Missing character 167 个）——pdflatex 无此问题
    pdf-engine: pdflatex
    keep-tex: true
    documentclass: article
    number-sections: true
    citeproc: false
    cite-method: natbib
    # 原版 main.tex 用 \usepackage[numbers,sort&compress]{natbib}（microsoft-tech-report.sty
    # 内部 RequirePackage 同选项）；quarto 的 natbiboptions 会把 & 转义/逗号丢失导致报错，
    # 因此 sty 已适配为 [numbers]（去 sort&compress），quarto 侧只需 [numbers] 一致加载
    natbiboptions: "numbers"
    biblio-style: unsrtnat
    latex-clean: false
    # 代码块走 listings 包（\lstset 样式；quarto 1.9+ 用
    # syntax-highlighting: idiomatic 替代已失效的 listings: true）
    syntax-highlighting: idiomatic
    # 图浮动体顶到页面顶端（原始论文 [t]/[!htbp] 风格；值会字面塞进
    # \begin{figure}[...]，须用 LaTeX 位置参数语法且加引号）
    fig-pos: "!t"
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          % --- Core packages (original main.tex) ---
          \usepackage{microtype}
          \usepackage{graphicx}
          \usepackage{subcaption}
          \usepackage{booktabs}
          \usepackage{microsoft-tech-report}
          \usepackage{hyperref}
          \usepackage{url}
          \usepackage{amsmath}
          \usepackage{amssymb}
          \usepackage{amsfonts}
          \usepackage{mathtools}
          \usepackage{amsthm}
          \usepackage{bm}
          \usepackage{nicefrac}
          \usepackage{enumitem}
          \usepackage{multirow}
          \usepackage{xspace}
          \usepackage{pifont}
          \usepackage{wrapfig}
          \usepackage{algorithm}
          \usepackage{algpseudocode}
          \usepackage{placeins}
          % --- Float placement tuning (original main.tex) ---
          \renewcommand{\topfraction}{0.92}
          \renewcommand{\bottomfraction}{0.0}
          \renewcommand{\textfraction}{0.07}
          \renewcommand{\floatpagefraction}{0.55}
          \setcounter{topnumber}{2}
          \setcounter{bottomnumber}{0}
          \setcounter{totalnumber}{2}
          \setlength{\textfloatsep}{14pt plus 2pt minus 4pt}
          % --- Author / project macros ---
          \newcommand{\ourmethod}{\textsc{SkillOpt}\xspace}
          \newcommand{\na}{--}
          % --- Delta-gain annotation (colored subscript; dvalp/dvaln add an
          % invisible left phantom so the black number stays column-centered) ---
          \definecolor{deltapos}{HTML}{0E8A4A}
          \definecolor{deltaneg}{HTML}{B91C1C}
          \newcommand{\dpos}[1]{\textsubscript{\textcolor{deltapos}{\,+#1}}}
          \newcommand{\dneg}[1]{\textsubscript{\textcolor{deltaneg}{\,$-$#1}}}
          \newcommand{\dvalp}[2]{\hphantom{\textsubscript{+#2}}#1\textsubscript{\textcolor{deltapos}{+#2}}}
          \newcommand{\dvaln}[2]{\hphantom{\textsubscript{$-$#2}}#1\textsubscript{\textcolor{deltaneg}{$-$#2}}}
          % --- Table helper macros ---
          \newcommand{\harnessrow}[1]{\rowcolor{black!7}\multicolumn{8}{l}{\textbf{#1}}}
          \newcommand{\methodcell}[1]{\cellcolor{blue!8}#1}
          \newcommand{\ablationbenchmarkheader}{\textbf{Setting} & \textbf{SearchQA} & \textbf{Spreadsheet} & \textbf{LiveMath} \\}
          % --- hyperref ---
          \hypersetup{
            colorlinks=true,
            linkcolor=msftblue,
            citecolor=msftblue,
            urlcolor=msftblue,
            pdftitle={SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills}
          }
  html:
    theme: cosmo
    toc: true
    number-sections: true
    css: styles.css
    bibliography: references.bib
    title: "SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills"
    html-helper:
      # HTML 端表格 caption 前缀（英文论文 "Table "；默认中文 "表 "）。
      # PDF 端 LaTeX 自动加 "Table N:"——两端一致。
      caption-prefix: "Table "
      caption-sep: ": "
      # 算法块独立编译所需宏包（lwarp 通道；与 PDF 端 include-in-header
      # 平行声明——块编译脱离文档层，包不从内容猜，此处显式声明）
      latex-packages:
        - algorithm
        - algpseudocode
        - amsmath
      # 算法块自定义宏（html-algorithm.lua 纯字符串翻译，不吃 latex-macros）：
      # \ourmethod{} → SkillOpt（HTML 端算法 caption 显示）
      algo-macros:
        "\\ourmethod{}": "SkillOpt"
      # 表格 caption 内的图引用 \ref{fig-X}：quarto crossref 不碰 RawBlock
      # 字符串（AST 层遍历），html-crossref.lua 输出占位符，由项目级
      # post-render 脚本 figref.py 在渲染完成后自动编号（数 <div id="fig-X"
      # class="quarto-float quarto-figure"> 文档顺序，与 PDF 端 \ref 一致）。
      # HTML 端表格子文档解析用的自定义宏（pandoc latex_macros 展开，通用配置；
      # 必须放 html 格式下——html-latex-tables.lua 是 HTML filter）。
      # dvalp/dvaln 是简化版（去掉 \hphantom——HTML 无需列居中幻影）；
      # 颜色用 CSS 合法 named color（LaTeX 的 deltapos HTML 色值不是 CSS 语法）。
      # harnessrow/methodcell 去掉 \rowcolor/\cellcolor/\multicolumn（pandoc 不认，
      # 预处理会把 \multicolumn 展开为内容文本）。
      latex-macros: |
        \newcommand{\ourmethod}{\textsc{SkillOpt}}
        \newcommand{\na}{--}
        \newcommand{\dvalp}[2]{#1\textsubscript{\textcolor{darkgreen}{+#2}}}
        \newcommand{\dvaln}[2]{#1\textsubscript{\textcolor{darkred}{$-$#2}}}
        \newcommand{\harnessrow}[1]{\textbf{#1}}
        \newcommand{\methodcell}[1]{#1}
        \newcommand{\ablationbenchmarkheader}{\textbf{Setting} & \textbf{SearchQA} & \textbf{Spreadsheet} & \textbf{LiveMath} \\}

\vspace{0.45em}
\begin{msfttitlebox}
\setlength{\parindent}{0cm}
\setlength{\parskip}{0.14cm}
\raggedright
\nohyphens

Agent skills today are hand-crafted, generated one-shot, or evolved through loosely controlled self-revision---none of which behaves like a deep-learning optimizer for the skill, and none of which reliably improves over its starting point under feedback. We argue the skill should instead be \emph{trained} as the external state of a frozen agent, with the same discipline that makes weight-space optimization reproducible. \ourmethod{} is, to our knowledge, the first systematic \emph{controllable} text-space optimizer for agent skills: a separate optimizer model turns scored rollouts into bounded add/delete/replace edits on a single skill document, and an edit is accepted only when it strictly improves a held-out validation score. A textual learning-rate budget, rejected-edit buffer, and epoch-wise slow/meta update make skill training stable while adding zero inference-time model calls at deployment. Across six benchmarks, seven target models, and three execution harnesses (direct chat, Codex, Claude Code), \ourmethod{} is best or tied on \textbf{all 52 evaluated (model, benchmark, harness) cells} and beats every per-cell competitor among human, one-shot LLM, Trace2Skill, TextGrad, GEPA, and EvoSkill skills. On GPT--5.5 it lifts the average no-skill accuracy by $\mathbf{+23.5}$ points in direct chat, by $+24.8$ inside the Codex agentic loop, and by $+19.1$ inside Claude Code. Transfer experiments further show that optimized skill artifacts retain value when moved across model scales, between Codex and Claude Code execution environments, and to a nearby math benchmark without further optimization.

<div class="hp-abstract">
Agent skills today are hand-crafted, generated one-shot, or evolved through loosely controlled self-revision---none of which behaves like a deep-learning optimizer for the skill, and none of which reliably improves over its starting point under feedback. We argue the skill should instead be <em>trained</em> as the external state of a frozen agent, with the same discipline that makes weight-space optimization reproducible. SkillOpt is, to our knowledge, the first systematic <em>controllable</em> text-space optimizer for agent skills: a separate optimizer model turns scored rollouts into bounded add/delete/replace edits on a single skill document, and an edit is accepted only when it strictly improves a held-out validation score. On GPT--5.5 it lifts the average no-skill accuracy by <strong>+23.5</strong> points in direct chat, by <strong>+24.8</strong> inside the Codex agentic loop, and by <strong>+19.1</strong> inside Claude Code. Transfer experiments further show that optimized skill artifacts retain value when moved across model scales, between Codex and Claude Code execution environments, and to a nearby math benchmark without further optimization.
